subject: Deal guardrails & contingency checklist — Novara commit window
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Quick sweep: Novara — R/Y/G classification + commits (deadline EOD PT)

Team — quick one: Finance asked for a cleaned commit view before EOD PT Monday so they can fold into the week close. Novara is flagged as a mid-risk opportunity; we need a definitive R/Y/G classification and a short save plan for yellow/red deals.

Can each of you do the following by EOD Monday (May 31):
- Update your rows in commit_tracker.csv (attached) with: current stage, proposed commit date, blocker notes (one sentence), and an R/Y/G flag.
- If you mark Y or R, add a 1-2 line save plan (who will call, what concession if any, and escalation step).
- Mark whether procurement needs SOC2 docs or PO first — Naomi, please confirm for Novara.

I'll consolidate and send a short external note to Claire confirming timelines and asking for PO window. Keep bullets short.

Attachments: commit_tracker.csv (spreadsheet)

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhao <claire.zhao@novara.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Novara timing check + minimal docs for procurement (short)

Hi Claire — thanks again for the time last week. Quick ask so we can lock the quarter forecast: where are you on the procurement timeline for the POC->production roll? Specifically:
- Is Novara expecting a PO by mid-June, or does legal need final SOC2 evidence before procurement will commit?
- Any chance we can get a soft commit window (best/worse case dates) so we can plan capacity for the dedicated pool?

I attached a short R/Y/G rationale deck that summarizes what we see as the remaining blockers and our recommended save steps. If it helps, we can offer a 30-day credit if the PO slips beyond June 30 while we keep resources reserved.

Attachments: RYG_deck_Novara_v3.pdf (PDF)

Appreciate it — Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Claire Zhao <claire.zhao@novara.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novara Procurement <procurement@novara.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novara timing check + minimal docs for procurement (short)

Marissa — thanks for the deck. Short answer: procurement is targeting a PO by 2027-06-10, but legal is asking for our SOC2 Type II report before they’ll finalize terms. That’s the main gating item.

We can give a soft window: PO expected 6/10 — worst case 6/24 if legal asks for minor contract edits. If you have a placeholder credit/hold option that keeps the dedicated capacity while legal finishes sign-off, that would be attractive.

Procurement contact: Jorge Mendez <jorge.mendez@novara.ai> (cc’d). I’ll loop legal if they need anything else.

Best — Claire
Senior Product Manager, Novara
claire.zhao@novara.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Deal guardrails & contingency checklist — Novara commit window

Thanks — good signal from Claire. Consolidating actions and proposed guardrails below (for HubSpot and Finance):

Summary (current):
- Soft commit window: 2027-06-10 (likely) / 2027-06-24 (worst).
- Legal requires SOC2 Type II before procurement will sign; procurement contact is Jorge Mendez.
- Current commit classification: Y (yellow) — block is legal evidence, not product fit.

Immediate actions (owners):
1) Naomi — confirm SOC2 evidence drop (file/attestation) and share direct link to legal. Add note in commit_tracker.csv row for Novara that points to the doc. (Deadline: EOD Tue 6/1)
2) Marcus — draft a short fall-through credit offer (30-day credit hold) and updated T&Cs for the channel that procurement can sign as a placeholder. We should avoid a deep discount; make it time-limited. Add draft to Drive. (Deadline: Thu 6/3)
3) Karthik — prep an SRE onboarding checklist and estimate ramp date if PO arrives 6/10 vs 6/24 (impact to dedicated pool capacity). This will let Finance model cost. (Deadline: Fri 6/4)
4) Marissa (me) — I’ll draft the external summary to Jorge/Claire with the save plan and credit option; I’ll send the canary offer once Marcus posts the draft. Also will update HubSpot (DEAL-3287) with R/Y/G and the dates. (Deadline: Tue 6/1)

Escalation rules if PO slips beyond 6/24:
- Auto-engage Sales Leadership for a one-time exec QBR with the customer and offer a capped credit (to be agreed) to cover staging while legal concludes.
- Consider moving capacity to dedicated pool reserved for near-term customers to avoid reallocation cost.

References: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/3287
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRYG
Attachments referenced: commit_tracker.csv (updated row needed), RYG_deck_Novara_v3.pdf

Please update your tracker rows as noted. I’ll collect and send a single external note to Jorge/Claire once Marcus confirms the credit language.

Thanks — Marissa
